seriesTitle: Fight Night: The Million Dollar Heist

episodes.title: Round One: The Ballad of Chicken Man
episodes.summary: Atlanta prepares for Muhammad Ali's comeback fight, and everyone wants a piece of the action.

episodes.title: Round Two: Fight Night
episodes.summary: As Chicken Man hustles to level up with the Black Mafia, local robbers find holes in his plans.

episodes.title: Round Three: Black Vegas
episodes.summary: The city celebrates Ali's big win, but Chicken Man's fight night party turns into a nightmare.

episodes.title: Round Four: Real Policework
episodes.summary: A desperate Chicken Man sets out to prove his innocence as the Black Mafia doubles down on revenge.

episodes.title: Round Five: Ambition Ain't Free
episodes.summary: On the run, Chicken Man forms an unlikely partnership as fight night fallout hits close to home.

episodes.title: Round Six: Community Men
episodes.summary: The manhunt for Chicken Man ramps up as he becomes front-page news; Detective Hudson goes rogue.

episodes.title: Round Seven: Jekyll Island
episodes.summary: Hudson and Chicken Man track the robbers to the Georgia coast; Vivian forges an unlikely alliance.

episodes.title: Round Eight: Testify
episodes.summary: Chicken Man and Hudson team up for one last big hustle, confronting the robbery mastermind.
